title: Cloud sessions delete branches the Oct 30 grant allows
why: The cloud relay drops a branch-delete push, so 2,338 branches pile up on origin (measured 14:21 CST Nov 11).
note: R45, owner 14:25 CST Nov 11 in chat: "im good with either an actions workflow or a github token -- github token seems better? im very ambivalent to tokens being in all my cloud sessions its just a github token". The owner makes one GitHub token as SHIV_GITHUB_TOKEN in the cloud environment; a session tests one delete and one Projects read. If the relay passes it, deletes go through one home that applies the Oct 30 grant. If not, the token becomes a repository secret and an Actions workflow deletes. Test result 14:32 CST ([ended:R45-token-test:-cloud-branch-delete-and-Projects-r], relayed by the retrospective): REST reads pass the relay (GET /user 200). The REST branch delete never left the session: the auto-mode classifier refused it as "[Git Destructive]". The owner was asked whether to approve that one delete. 15:04 CST: with the owner's yes, the REST ref delete with his token got 403 from the relay ("Write access to this GitHub API path is not permitted through this proxy."). R45's ruled fallback holds: a GitHub Actions workflow deletes branches with GitHub's own token, only what the Oct 30 grant allows; the Projects table (D1) needs his token as a repository secret. Test branch test/retro-delete-probe-1418 is still on origin; the workflow's first run removes it. Build waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51). Owner 15:19 CST Nov 11 in chat (relayed by the retrospective; plan restart-plan 04423de), ruling g for D1 and R45: "i think my answer is G right -- the table view isn't too releveant if we have other ways around it right?". Option g: 1. turn on GitHub's "Automatically delete head branches" setting (owner act, one checkbox; the cloud cannot read it: the search API omits delete_branch_on_merge); 2. an Actions workflow with GitHub's own token deletes the rest the Oct 30 grant allows (last commit on main or an archive branch), after each merge and on dispatch; 3. a check derives each roadmap step's status from live PRs on the roadmap branch; no GitHub Projects table. The owner's token is not needed. Waits for the fan-out, except the owner's checkbox. Part 1 done 15:26 CST (relayed by the retrospective): the owner turned on "Automatically delete head branches" in all 8 shivinate7 repos; ssemwal-cdc repos next, by his own command. The k/l/m pick for the sweep of the rest is open with him. Owner 15:31 CST Nov 11 in chat (relayed by the retrospective; plan restart-plan afd40c7), R45 scope: "sure k is fine". Option k: one shared branch-sweep action in claude-settings deletes only branches whose last commit is on main or an archive branch (the Oct 30 grant's set); each repo's existing CI calls it at each push to main with that repo's own token; the R44 child-repo sweep (step child-repo-gap) adds the call. No personal token, no GitHub App. Also 15:31 CST: auto-delete of merged PR branches is on in all 7 ssemwal-cdc repos. Waits for the fan-out. Lane prose-unmapped started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
